items.item_text: Experience using and working with cleaning supplies in a professional environment.
Experience to answer phone calls, email and communicate via email.
Experience using cleaning equipment and agents.
Experience using safe animal handling and restraint techniques for a wide variety of patients.
Experience working in a small animal veterinary hospital.

Want to be part of the most innovative veterinary team in the country? We are looking for a Nutrition Animal Technician to work alongside our world leading faculty clinicians and technicians, helping them teach the next generation of veterinarians while also serving the animals and pet owners of our community.
As part of the top ranked UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital team, our technicians are provided with the following benefits:

Under the direction of the Small Animal Nutrition Supervisor and the Nutrition Service Faculty, maintain all therapeutic and nontherapeutic diets as well as other supplies. Responsible for inventory, ordering, stocking and assisting clients with food orders. Update billing. Clean food preparation area and make sure equipment is clean and in working order. Sweep and mop the food storage area as needed. Monitor and record patient vital functions; maintain supply inventory and equipment; perform feeding, hospitalization and discharge procedures according to protocol.
Skill to assist in the performance of veterinary medical treatments and procedures.
Knowledge of common hospital pathogens & methods of disinfection.
Skills to maintain inventory of supplies.
Knowledge of medical terminology, surgical instruments, & diseases.
Interpersonal skills to work with a diverse group of people, to include clients, clinicians, students and staff.
